name: Beijing Chunlizhengda Medical Instruments Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Chunlizhengda Medical Instruments Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of surgical implants, instruments, and related products in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers orthopedic medical devices and tissue repair products, including spine, trauma, joint, sports medicine, and bone repair material implants; surgical instrumentation products; platelet-rich plasma preparation kits; and closed wound negative pressure drainage kits.
